subject: Marketplace listing: support hours & co-sell collateral tone (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-12-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace listing: support hours + co-sell collateral tone

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We pulled together internal requirements for the marketplace listing and a few asks around co-sell collateral tone before we go live. High level:

- Support SLA: We need our listing to reflect 24x5 primary support with 24x7 critical incident routing (pager) for production incidents. Current Redwood draft says 9-5 support which won't work for us.
- Branding/claims: Legal flagged two claims that reference "enterprise-grade encryption" and "unlimited snapshots" — those are eyebrow-raising. Can you confirm exact wording you plan to surface in the marketplace copy?
- Co-sell collateral: Our GTM team wants the collateral to emphasize "regulated healthcare-ready" language and call out the SOC / encryption controls succinctly; please avoid vague marketing phrases like "unlimited availability" or "always-on support".

I've attached the requirements doc, a rough SLA matrix, and the draft collateral we've been given to align against. Can we get an internal confirmation by EOD Monday so we can keep the AWS listing window?

Thanks,
Mike
Mike Jensen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Health

Attachments: acme_support_requirements.docx (docx), desired_sla_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), co-sell_collateral_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-18T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: support hours + co-sell collateral tone

Mike — thanks for the clear asks and the attachments. Looping Karthik for the SLA wording and Vanessa for listing/collateral flow. Quick plan:

1) SLA language: Karthik will propose precise copy that maps to our support model and your 24x5 / 24x7 critical routing. If any capability gaps exist we will call them out (e.g., optional premium on-call add-on).
2) Claims review: I will scrub the marketplace copy for specific claims (encryption, snapshots) and replace hard adjectives with verifiable statements (e.g., refer to AES-256 at rest, point to our KMS integrations).
3) Collateral tone: Vanessa will produce a short co-sell one-pager that uses "regulated" and "compliance-ready" language and avoids absolute promises.

Karthik / Vanessa — can you both review the attached SLA matrix and collateral and send proposed edits by EOD today? Mike, we'll aim to deliver an updated collateral + marketplace copy for your review by tomorrow morning so you can hit the listing window.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

> On 2027-12-18 09:14, Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> > (see attachments)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-18T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: support hours + co-sell collateral tone

Thanks Marissa — quick pass from engineering/ops on the SLA matrix and claim language. Key notes inline: 

- Support hours: We can commit to 24x5 for standard support. For 24x7 critical incident routing we have an escalation path that integrates with on-call rotations; however, multi-week guaranteed 24x7 human coverage is part of our Dedicated/enterprise plan. Suggest marketplace copy: "Primary support: 24x5; Critical incident escalation: 24x7 on-call routing (covered under enterprise support package)."

- Encryption claim: Replace "enterprise-grade encryption" with "AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit; customer-managed keys supported via KMS."

- Snapshots: Remove "unlimited snapshots" — instead: "Automated daily snapshots retained up to 90 days (configurable)."

I've attached a redlined SLA matrix (desired_sla_matrix_redlined.xlsx) and a short proposed marketplace blurb (marketplace_blurb_v1.txt). Vanessa — I kept the blurb concise so it fits partner listing character limits.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: desired_sla_matrix_redlined.xlsx (xlsx), marketplace_blurb_v1.txt (txt)

> On 2027-12-18 11:02, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> > (planning notes)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: support hours + co-sell collateral tone

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear list. Per Karthik's recommendations above, attached is an updated one-pager and the marketplace copy we will submit to AWS/GCP/Azure listing portals: concise, compliance-first, and with the SLA note we discussed. Summary of changes: 

- Support: "Primary support: 24x5; Critical incident escalation: 24x7 on-call routing available (enterprise support)."
- Encryption: explicit reference to AES-256 at rest + KMS support.
- Snapshots: replaced with configurable snapshot retention (default 90 days).
- Tone edits: removed marketing absolutes (e.g., "always-on"); added "regulated healthcare-ready" and a short compliance bullet list.

Next steps:
- If that copy looks good, Marissa / I will submit the listing updates this afternoon to AWS Partner Central and queue GCP/Azure using the same blurb.
- Mike: please confirm you have legal signoff on the revised wording by EOD today so we can keep the listing window.

Links: Partner listing preview: https://partnercentral.aws.amazon.com/listings/ACME-Health (preview)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ACME-2027-DEC-011

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
